title: Denoising Diffusion with Progressive Posterior Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2611.31558v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models provide effective generative priors for solving noisy linear inverse problems. However, existing posterior sampling methods may require singular value decomposition (SVD) of the measurement operator or prior knowledge of the measurement noise variance, while guidance based on local gradients provides only a limited view of posterior geometry. We propose progressive posterior sampling (PPS) with manifold projection, which automatically estimates the measurement noise variance and avoids SVD. During reverse diffusion, PPS constructs a Gaussian approximation to the posterior distribution in closed form and guides a sample drawn from the local prior toward the approximate posterior mean. We then project the guided sample onto a spherical level set that approximates the local noisy image manifold, promoting consistency with the local geometry of the diffusion prior. translated_title: 基于渐进后验采样的去噪扩散
translated_abstract: 扩散模型为求解含噪线性逆问题提供了有效的生成先验。然而，现有的后验采样方法可能需要对测量算子进行奇异值分解（SVD），或者需要预先知晓测量噪声的方差，而基于局部梯度的引导仅能提供对后验几何结构的有限视角。我们提出了一种带流形投影的渐进后验采样（PPS）方法，该方法能够自动估计测量噪声方差并避免SVD。在反向扩散过程中，PPS以闭式形式构建后验分布的高斯近似，并将从局部先验中抽取的样本引导至近似后验均值。随后，我们将引导后的样本投影到一个近似局部含噪图像流形的球面水平集上，从而促进样本与扩散先验局部几何结构的一致性。在FFHQ和ImageNet数据集上跨越四种图像修复任务的实验……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出带流形投影的渐进后验采样（PPS）方法，通过闭式高斯后验近似自动估计噪声方差、避免SVD，并将样本投影至局部含噪图像流形，从而更有效地利用扩散先验的局部几何结构求解含噪线性逆问题。
